example.title: Grocery market with a big gabled entrance and glazed front
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 2010s single-storey supermarket: a long low box of grey and white panels with a continuous glazed front and a deep flat canopy, a tall pale-grey gabled entrance pavilion carrying a script name sign, planters of olive trees and a surface car park with palms. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
